results.name: pin
notes: 320x240 layered window with opaque center, premultiplied-alpha border and transparent margin. Capture compares opaque RGB exactly; blended RGB allows one channel level of compositor rounding.
100 create/present/destroy cycles. Pixel checks run at 100% and 80% global opacity on the first and last cycles. This prototype does not implement P4 pin interactions.
